name: Acceptance suite-3 test 81 - asterisk inside a role Principal ARN is invalid
note: IAM-1004 (Phase 10) Campaign D: the IAM Principal element cannot use a partial '*' wildcard to match multiple principal ARNs (AWS rejects it at save time); only the standalone Principal "*" is a valid wildcard. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/application/* must fail closed to TRUST-INVALID-PRINCIPAL (located at Principal.AWS[0]), never a plain TRUST-CROSS-ACCOUNT expansion, and coverage carries INVALID_PRINCIPAL_WILDCARD_ARN.
